## What Conterval does

[All services →](services.qmd)
:::

::: {.ledger}
### [Machine learning](services.qmd#machine-learning)

Forecasting, classification and ranking models, evaluated honestly and deployed where your team can run them.

### [ETL and data engineering](services.qmd#etl)

Data cleaning, reliable pipelines and analytics engineering that turn raw data into tested tables your analysts can trust.

### [Data visualization](services.qmd#visualization)

Dashboards and charts that answer a specific question and get opened more than once.

### [Applied AI](services.qmd#applied-ai)

LLM features and document search built on your own data, with evaluation in place before launch.

### [Statistics and experimentation](services.qmd#statistics)

A/B tests, causal analysis and estimates that come with a range, so a decision can weigh the risk.

### [Training](services.qmd#training)

Hands-on workshops that leave your team able to maintain the work, built on [books](books.qmd) and [courses](https://www.udemy.com/user/joram-mutenge/) about Polars and pandas.
:::

[How an engagement runs]{.eyebrow}

## Small scope first, then build.

::: {.steps}
### Scope

Start from the decision the work should improve, check the data can support it, and agree what success looks like.

### Build

Deliver in short cycles against real data, so you see working output early and can change direction cheaply.

### Hand over

Finish with documented code, tests and a walkthrough, so your team owns the result.
:::
